character.lede: A slate-blue Cape Cod cottage has a steep fish-scale roof, two dormers and a red-brick entry bay with an arched door. Railed porches on either side look onto beds of flowers.

spots.line: A single bed, a toy box and a low bookshelf make Chidi's corner.
A kettle, a fruit bowl and café curtains brighten the small kitchen.
A loveseat, a slipper chair and a rug make the front room.

facts.style: Slate-blue clapboard Cape Cod cottage: steep brown fish-scale side gable, two dormers, a red-brick gabled entry bay with an arched blue door, railed brick-floored porches either side, an end chimney and a lower bath wing

character.truths: The Core sits on a shelf in the Living Room, in sight of the door. The only television is in the bedroom: never place a TV scene elsewhere. The kitchen has no island. A small cottage with porches and flower beds.
mustNot: no television in any room but the bedroom

details.rule: every beat of an adult or teen persona (13 or older) gets a detail (before, after, steps, fact); pair beats first

kitchenowl: [note] Learns from your list habits per its manifest.
kiwix: marketplace: Ships with an empty library: the compose runs kiwix-serve on /data/library.xml with no content and no way in the Hub to add or register ZIM files; the QA capture shows "No result".
koodo-reader: marketplace: Listing text says nothing is sent to a cloud service; the reader has outside-calling features (translation, lookup, speech).
syncthing: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
photoprism: [note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
radicale: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
no QA screenshot (the app has a bare web page)
sync away from home is not claimed
jellyfin: [note] Plays your own files. Say that, not "Netflix".
[claims] Do not say it plays copyrighted material from anywhere.
Plays your own media only: never "streams any movie".
QA capture is the setup wizard with a container id as the server name; the gallery frame is a demo library with lurid exploitation film posters: neither usable.
firefly-iii: [cloud-link] Bank import through GoCardless or Spectre is an outside service. CSV import stays local.
[claims] Bookkeeping tool. No financial advice and no savings promises.
marketplace: Replaces lists Mint, which Intuit retired in 2024.
libreoffice: [note] The listing is generic. Name the suite, not specific features.
[note] ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors does the same job: one suite per household.
hortusfox: Do not say it keeps plants alive
Plant health alerts and a public gallery exist: keep the gallery off in a story
frigate: [hardware] Needs IP cameras that stream over RTSP. Cameras are not part of the Core.
[public-access] Watching cameras from away from home is remote access, which the sheet leaves unfinished.
[claims] No detection-speed or accuracy numbers. Do not say it prevents anything.
QA screenshot shows "No frames have been received, check error logs": reject. The store listing image shows a real backyard photo that is not a Hub capture.
Watching away from home is remote access: not claimed.
tandoor: [note] Overlaps Mealie; pick one per story.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
freshrss: Pulls feeds from the sites over the internet by nature
Fever and Google Reader APIs let phone readers connect (the phone app is the reader's own)
excalidraw: [note] amd64 only. An Excalidraw MCP entry exists for agents.
marketplace: Manifest source points to ozencb/excalidraw-persist, a 105-star wrapper, not excalidraw/excalidraw.
habitica: The sign-up page in the capture carries a cookie-consent banner: check the self-hosted build for analytics scripts before saying it sends nothing out
Game, not a health or behaviour tool: no outcomes
searxng: [cloud-link] It queries outside search engines for you. Say "private search", not "offline search".
cloud-link: the engines still see the query from the Core
listing says users are not tracked: do not repeat
endurain: [cloud-link] Optional sync with Strava and Garmin Connect. Bulk GPX and FIT upload is local.
Strava and Garmin sync are outside links: say bulk upload is the local path
GPS history is location data: story must not map a home address
jotty: Public share links need outside reach
Everything is Markdown and JSON files, no database
karakeep: [cloud-link] The install form asks for an OpenAI key. Automatic tagging can use a local model instead; do not imply the key is needed.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
AI tagging is optional: never imply the key is needed (catalog)
Listing names OpenAI or a self-hosted Ollama; only the OpenAI route is in the form
mstream: Description says "from anywhere", "completely private" and "no data collection": absolute and remote claims, paraphrase

reminders: popup title at most six words, body at most thirty, no digits, no dashes, no exclamation; second chip reads "alternative to <Service>"
name an app exactly as its display name; one app per beat, others in `with`
seeds are moments, not copy: rewrite them in the house voice and keep what is true
